gaps.term: Multitape bound for Harvey and van der Hoeven
gaps.quote: Since the conjecture concerns multitape machines, this gives an $O(n\log n)$ multitape algorithm.
gaps.note: The page says the Harvey and van der Hoeven bound is an unconditional O(n log n) bound 'for the same problem' but never states the machine model it is proved in. The reader cannot check that it is a multitape bound, so the conclusion that it gives a multitape algorithm is not followable from the page.
